title: 第七章 最后一日
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

9月15日，星期一。

距离病毒爆发，还有不到十二个小时。

林越站在冷库二楼的窗前，看着东边的天际线从铁灰色变成浅蓝，再变成淡金。这是他重生以来第一次完整地看完一场日出。也可能是最后一次能安安静静看完的日出。

楼下传来柴油机的轰鸣声。

那台停了五年的老柴油发电机，在昨晚十一点四十七分重新转了起来。王浩用了整整一天一夜，把三个喷油嘴换了，机油滤清器换上新的，高压油管实在买不到原厂件，他用角磨机切了一块钢板做了转接法兰，把一根通用油管硬接了上去。柴油机启动的那一刻，整个配电房的灯泡同时亮了，胖子的欢呼声穿过配电房的铁门，传到冷库门口，赵铭愣了一下才反应过来——那是王浩在笑。他从加入这个团队以来第一次笑出声。

林越走下楼梯的时候，柴油机已经稳定运转了将近八个小时。王浩裹着一件到处是油污的棉大衣，蜷在配电房角落的一把破椅子上睡着了，手里还攥着一把扳手。林越没有叫醒他。他轻轻把扳手从王浩手里抽出来，放在旁边的工具箱上，然后关上了配电房的门。

冷库门口，赵铭和老郑已经在装车了。今天要去赵家沟，林越选了那辆底盘最高的面包车。远郊的路况他前世走过，最后五公里是土路，坑坑洼洼，一下雨就翻浆。天气预报说今天晴，但他不打算赌。

“带了多少东西？”林越走过去。

“三袋大米，一桶油，两箱压缩饼干。”老郑拍了拍车厢里的物资，然后弯腰从座位底下拿出一个布袋子，

林越看着烟酒，嘴角动了一下。

“班长。”他用了前世赵铭对老郑的称呼，“你连这个都想到了。”

“农村跑过。”老郑把布袋子重新系好，“你空着手跟人说世界末日让人搬家，谁也不信。但你要是坐下来跟他抽根烟、喝杯酒，再怎么说，他至少听你讲完。”

林越点头。末世里最稀缺的东西不是子弹，是说服力。赵德柱的性格他前世知道——沉默寡言，软硬不吃，但他认土地，认手艺，认那些不说话的植物比认人多。这种人，常规的说服方式完全无效。必须用他听得懂的语言。土地的语言。

“林哥，”赵铭把驾驶座的门拉开，“我来开。”

“不用。今天你留基地。”林越接过钥匙，坐进驾驶座，“老郑跟我去。赵铭，你是战斗组组长，我走之后基地安全由你和陆寒霜负责。今天任何人不准出大门，任何外来车辆不准靠近。如果有政府的人来问，就说我们在做冷库改造施工，合同在二楼抽屉里。”

赵铭沉默了片刻，然后说：“你几点回来？”

“下午两点之前。”林越发动引擎。

面包车驶出物流园大门的时候，林越从后视镜里看到了陆寒霜。她站在正门哨塔的临时脚手架上——昨晚刚搭起来的，由钢架和木板拼凑，只能站一个人，视野可以覆盖正门外三百米——正在调试一把步枪的瞄准镜。她昨晚又回去了一趟，凌晨两点才回来，带回来三把半自动步枪、五个弹匣和一个装备箱。她没有解释枪的来源，林越也没有问。

车子开出北郊工业区，拐上通往赵家沟的县道。路上的车流正在多起来——周一早高峰，赶着上班的人潮铺满了整条路。林越在红绿灯前停车的时候，旁边车道的一辆黑色轿车里，一个穿西装的年轻男人正在对着后视镜打领带，嘴里咬着半个面包。人行道上，一群穿着校服的中学生正说说笑笑地往学校方向走，书包在背上晃来晃去。

老郑坐在副驾驶上，目光扫过窗外的街景，沉默了一会儿，然后说：“他们都不知道。”

“不知道。”林越说。

“我们能救多少？”

这是第二个问他这个问题的人。昨天赵铭问过，今天老郑问。林越握着方向盘，看着前方的车流，说了一模一样的话：“能救多少救多少。但不能为了救人把基地搭进去。”

老郑没有再问。

车子驶出城区之后，路两旁的风景开始变成农田和散落的村庄。赵家沟在城北远郊的丘陵地带，是那种还没被城市化吞掉的老村子，水泥路只铺到村口，往里走全是土路。林越把车速放慢，凭着前世的记忆，在岔路口拐了三次，最终停在了一户农家小院门口。

院门是两扇褪色的木门，没锁，虚掩着。从门缝里可以看到院子里种满了菜——小白菜、萝卜、蒜苗，一畦一畦，整整齐齐，像是用尺子量过。院墙根堆着农具，锄头、铁锹、粪叉，每一把都擦得干干净净，没有半点锈迹。

林越站在门口看了一眼这些农具，心里就有了底。工具的状态说明使用者的状态。这些农具的主人，是一个对土地认真到骨子里的人。

他推开门，走了进去。

赵德柱正蹲在院子东南角的菜畦边上，背对着门，手里拿着一个小铲子在给蒜苗松土。他穿着深蓝色的旧式中山装，袖口卷到手肘，露出两条被太阳晒成古铜色的胳膊。花白的头发剪得很短，从背后看，他的脊背微微弓着，但肩膀很宽，是一个在土地上干了一辈子活的人特有的身形。

“赵叔。”林越站在院子中间，没有走近。

赵德柱回过头。一张被风霜刻满了沟壑的脸，眉毛很浓，已经灰了大半。他打量了林越一眼，目光平静，没有任何惊讶。一个陌生人突然出现在自家院子里，他的第一反应不是警惕，而是等——等对方先说明来意。这种沉得住气的性格，是在土地上磨了几十年才磨出来的。

“你是谁？”赵德柱的声音低哑，但不含敌意。

“我叫林越。从城里来的。”

“我不认识你。”

“你不认识我。但我认识你。”林越说，“我知道你是赵家沟最好的农人。你的地在山坡上，是一片别人不要的盐碱地。你用三年把它改成了良田。你不打农药，不用化肥，全靠绿肥和轮作。你的小麦亩产比别人高两成。你的白萝卜甜得能当水果吃。”

赵德柱的眉毛动了一下。他把小铲子插在土里，站起身来，用挂在脖子上的毛巾擦了擦手。这个动作很慢，像是在争取思考的时间。

“你调查过我？”

“没有。”林越说，“有些事不需要调查。”

老郑从门口走进来，把手里提着的布袋子放在院子里的石桌上，然后退到一边，没有说话。

“赵叔，”林越指了指石桌，“坐下来聊两句行不行？”

赵德柱看了他一眼，又看了老郑一眼，然后走到石桌旁坐下来。没有拿烟，没有碰酒，只是把手放在膝盖上，安静地等着。

林越在他对面坐下。

“赵叔，我没有很多时间铺垫，就直说了。今天下午五点钟左右，这座城市会爆发一种病毒。感染的人会变成咬人的怪物，被咬的人也会感染。十二个小时之内，整个城南会沦陷。四十八小时之内，全城会进入军事封锁。这个消息听起来像疯话。我没办法给你看证据，因为证据要到今天下午五点才会出现。但我今天必须来，因为一旦爆发，赵家沟会断水断电断路，到时候我再想来接你，就进不来了。”

赵德柱听完，没有任何表情变化。他沉默了一会儿，然后说：“你今年多大？”

“二十六。”

“二十六。”赵德柱点了一下头，“二十六岁的人跟我说世界末日。你凭什么觉得我会信？”

“凭一个理由。”林越说。

“什么理由？”

“地。”

赵德柱的眼睛眯了一下。

“赵叔，你今年五十八。你在土地上干了一辈子。你种过的地加在一起，比整个赵家沟还大。”林越身体微微前倾，“但如果这座城市乱了，没有人再种地了。没有人浇水，没有人施肥，没有人除草。不出三个月，所有的农田都会荒成野地。不出一年，方圆几百里之内，能吃的东西全部消失。不是被抢光的，是自己烂掉的。因为没有人去收。”

赵德柱的眼皮跳了一下。极轻微的一跳，但林越捕捉到了。

“你想说什么？”

“我想说——如果末日来了，你的手艺比枪还值钱。枪能打死丧尸，但不能让一片荒地产出粮食。你能。”林越说，“北郊有一个冷链物流园。我租下来了。里面有水泥墙，有发电机，有铁丝网防线，有药品和汽油。但里面的地是荒地，寸草不生。我需要一个人把那块地变成农田。”

赵德柱沉默了片刻，然后站了起来。他走到菜畦旁边，弯腰拔了一根白萝卜，在旁边的水桶里冲了两下，然后走回来递给林越。

Page (1/3)

Monday, September 15th.

There are less than twelve hours until the virus breaks out.

Lin Yue stood in front of the window on the second floor of the cold storage, watching the eastern skyline change from iron gray to light blue, and then to light gold.This was the first time since his rebirth that he had watched a complete sunrise.It may also be the last sunrise that I can watch quietly.

The roar of a diesel engine could be heard downstairs.

The old diesel generator that had been idle for five years started running again at 11:47 last night.Wang Hao spent a whole day and night replacing the three fuel injectors, replacing the oil filter with new ones, and since original parts for the high-pressure oil pipe were unavailable, he used an angle grinder to cut a steel plate to make an adapter flange and hard-connected a universal oil pipe to it.The moment the diesel engine started, the light bulbs in the entire power distribution room lit up at the same time. The fat man's cheers passed through the iron door of the power distribution room and reached the door of the cold storage. Zhao Ming was stunned for a moment before he realized that it was Wang Hao laughing.He laughed out loud for the first time since joining the team.

When Lin Yue walked down the stairs, the diesel engine had been running stably for nearly eight hours.Wang Hao was wrapped in a cotton coat that was stained everywhere, curled up on a broken chair in the corner of the power distribution room and fell asleep, with a wrench in his hand.Lin Yue did not wake him up.He gently took the wrench out of Wang Hao's hand, placed it on the tool box next to him, and then closed the door of the power distribution room.

At the entrance of the cold storage, Zhao Ming and Lao Zheng were already loading the truck.Going to Zhaojiagou today, Lin Yue chose the van with the highest chassis.He had experienced the road conditions in the outer suburbs in his previous life. The last five kilometers were dirt roads with many potholes and would turn muddy when it rained.The weather forecast said it would be sunny today, but he wasn't going to gamble.

"How many things did you bring?" Lin Yue walked over.

"Three bags of rice, a barrel of oil, and two boxes of compressed biscuits." Old Zheng patted the supplies in the carriage, then bent down and took out a cloth bag from under the seat.

Lin Yue looked at the tobacco and wine, and the corners of his mouth moved.

"Squad leader." He used the name Zhao Ming used to call Lao Zheng in his previous life, "You even thought of this."

"Running through the countryside." Lao Zheng tied the bag again, "You tell people with nothing that the end of the world will make people move, and no one will believe it. But if you sit down to smoke a cigarette and have a glass of wine with him, no matter what you say, he will at least listen to what you have to say."

Lin Yue nodded.The most scarce thing in the apocalypse is not bullets, but persuasion.He knew Zhao Dezhu's character in his previous life - he was taciturn and did not like hard and soft things, but he recognized the land, the craftsmanship, and the silent plants more than he recognized people.For such people, conventional persuasion methods are completely ineffective.It must be in a language he understands.The language of the land.

"Brother Lin," Zhao Ming opened the driver's door, "I'll open it."

"No. You stay at the base today." Lin Yue took the key and got into the driver's seat. "Old Zheng, follow me. Zhao Ming, you are the leader of the combat team. After I leave, you and Lu Hanshuang will be responsible for the security of the base. No one is allowed to go out of the gate today, and no outside vehicles are allowed to approach. If anyone from the government comes to ask, just say that we are doing cold storage renovation construction, and the contract is in the drawer on the second floor."

Zhao Ming was silent for a moment, and then said: "When will you come back?"

"Before two o'clock in the afternoon." Lin Yue started the engine.

When the van drove out of the logistics park gate, Lin Yue saw Lu Hanshuang in the rearview mirror.She was standing on the temporary scaffolding of the main gate guard tower - it was just erected last night. It was made up of steel frames and wooden boards. Only one person could stand on it, and her field of view could cover three hundred meters outside the main gate - and she was adjusting the scope of a rifle.She went back again last night and came back at two in the morning, bringing back three semi-automatic rifles, five magazines and an equipment box.She didn't explain the origin of the gun, and Lin Yue didn't ask.

The car drove out of the northern suburbs industrial zone and turned onto the county road leading to Zhaojiagou.The traffic on the road is increasing - during the Monday morning rush hour, the entire road is covered with people rushing to work.When Lin Yue stopped at the traffic light, in a black car in the lane next to him, a young man in a suit was tying a tie in front of the rearview mirror, holding half a piece of bread in his mouth.On the sidewalk, a group of middle school students in school uniforms were walking toward school, talking and laughing, with schoolbags dangling on their backs.

Lao Zheng sat in the passenger seat and glanced at the street scene outside the window. He was silent for a while and then said, "They don't know."

"I don't know." Lin Yue said.

"How much can we save?"

This is the second person to ask him this question.Zhao Ming asked yesterday, and Lao Zheng asked today.Lin Yue held the steering wheel, looked at the traffic ahead, and said exactly the same thing: "Save as many people as you can. But you can't build a base just to save people."

Lao Zheng didn't ask again.

After the car drove out of the city, the scenery on both sides of the road began to turn into farmland and scattered villages.Zhaojiagou is located in the hilly area in the northern suburbs of the city. It is an old village that has not been swallowed up by urbanization. The cement road is only paved to the entrance of the village, and all the way inside is dirt road.Lin Yue slowed down the car, and based on his past life memories, he turned three times at the fork in the road and finally stopped at the entrance of a small farmhouse.

The courtyard gate is two faded wooden doors, unlocked and ajar.From the crack in the door, you can see that the yard is full of vegetables - cabbage, radish, garlic seedlings, neatly arranged in rows, as if measured with a ruler.There are farm tools piled at the root of the courtyard wall, including hoes, shovels, and manure forks. Each one has been wiped clean without any rust.

Lin Yue stood at the door and took a look at these farm tools, feeling confident.The tool's status describes the user's status.The owner of these farm tools is a man who is serious about the land to his core.

He opened the door and walked in.

Zhao Dezhu was squatting beside the vegetable bed in the southeast corner of the yard, with his back to the door, holding a small shovel in his hand to loosen the soil of the garlic seedlings.He was wearing a dark blue old-style tunic suit, with the cuffs rolled up to his elbows, revealing two arms that had been tanned by the sun.His gray hair is cut very short. Viewed from behind, his back is slightly arched, but his shoulders are broad. He has the unique figure of a man who has worked on the land all his life.

"Uncle Zhao." Lin Yue stood in the middle of the yard and did not come closer.

Zhao Dezhu turned around.He had a face full of ravines carved by wind and frost, and his eyebrows were thick and most of them were gray.He looked at Lin Yue with a calm look, without any surprise.When a stranger suddenly appeared in his yard, his first reaction was not to be wary, but to wait for the stranger to explain his purpose first.This kind of calm character was developed after decades of hard work on the land.

"Who are you?" Zhao Dezhu's voice was low and hoarse, but not hostile.

"My name is Lin Yue. I'm from the city."

"I don't know you."

"You don't know me. But I know you." Lin Yue said, "I know you are the best farmer in Zhaojiagou. Your land is on a hillside, a piece of saline-alkali land that others don't want. It took you three years to transform it into fertile land. You don't use pesticides or chemical fertilizers, and rely solely on green manure and crop rotation. Your wheat yield per acre is 20% higher than others. Your white radish is so sweet that it can be eaten as fruit."

Zhao Dezhu's eyebrows moved.He stuck the shovel into the soil, stood up, and wiped his hands with the towel hanging around his neck.This movement is very slow, as if to buy time to think.

"Have you investigated me?"

"No." Lin Yue said, "Some things don't need investigation."

Lao Zheng walked in from the door, put the cloth bag he was carrying on the stone table in the yard, and then stepped aside without saying a word.

"Uncle Zhao," Lin Yue pointed to the stone table, "Can we sit down and have a chat?"

Zhao Dezhu glanced at him, then at Lao Zheng, then walked to the stone table and sat down.He didn't take out the cigarette or touch the wine, he just put his hands on his knees and waited quietly.

Lin Yue sat down opposite him.

"Uncle Zhao, I don't have much time to pave the way, so I'll just say it straight away. Around five o'clock this afternoon, a virus will break out in this city. Those infected will turn into biting monsters, and those bitten will also be infected. Within twelve hours, the entire south of the city will fall. Within forty-eight hours, the entire city willThere will be a military blockade.This news sounds like crazy talk.I can't show you the evidence, because the evidence will not appear until five o'clock this afternoon, but I have to come today, because if it breaks out, Zhaojiagou will lose water, power and electricity, and I won't be able to come in if I want to come."

After hearing this, Zhao Dezhu's expression did not change.He was silent for a moment and then said, "How old are you?"

"Twenty-six."

"Twenty-six." Zhao Dezhu nodded, "A twenty-six-year-old man told me that the world is going to end. Why do you think I will believe it?"

"For a reason." Lin Yue said.

"What reason?"

"Ground."

Zhao Dezhu's eyes narrowed.

"Uncle Zhao, you are fifty-eight this year. You have worked on the land all your life. The land you have planted together is larger than the entire Zhaojiagou." Lin Yue leaned forward slightly, "But if this city is in chaos, no one will farm anymore. No one will water it.No one fertilizes, no one weeds.Within three months, all the farmland will be barren.Within a year, everything edible will be gone, because no one will harvest it.”

Zhao Dezhu's eyelids twitched.It was a very slight jump, but Lin Yue caught it.

"What do you want to say?"

"I want to say - if the doomsday comes, your skills are more valuable than guns. Guns can kill zombies, but they can't make a wasteland produce food. You can." Lin Yue said, "There is a cold chain logistics park in the northern suburbs. I rented it. There are cement walls, generators, barbed wire defense lines, medicine and gasoline. But the land inside is wasteland, with no grass growing. I need someone to turn that land into farmland."

Zhao Dezhu was silent for a moment, and then stood up.He walked to the vegetable patch, bent down and pulled out a white radish, rinsed it twice in the bucket next to it, then walked back and handed it to Lin Yue.
